Overview of Seoul Region (서울특별시)

Seoul Region (서울특별시) is located in the Seoul region of South Korea, with its prefectural capital at Seoul. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Gyeongbokgung & Bukchon Hanok Village, Myeongdong, Hongdae & Seongsu-dong, N Seoul Tower & Cheonggyecheon, Insadong & Dongdaemun DDP.

RegionSeoul
Capital citySeoul
Cities & municipalities61
Primary transport hubSeoul Central Station (KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail)

How to get to Seoul Region

AREX Airport Railroad from Incheon (ICN) & Gimpo (GMP); 9+ subway lines and KTX hub at Seoul Station & Yongsan. Use our KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Seoul

When visiting cities across Seoul, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Korean BBQ
  • Gwangjang Market bindaetteok
  • Michelin & pojangmacha dining
  • Chimaek (fried chicken & beer)
  • Royal court cuisine

Best time to visit Seoul

Best time to visit Seoul: Apr–May, Sep–Nov.
